# Domain Tech Hub

> Domain Tech Hub is a premier digital technology and senior web engineering agency headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. We engineer high-performance web applications, Safaricom Daraja 3.0 M-Pesa e-commerce systems, conversion-driven digital marketing engines, and custom enterprise software.

## Key Capabilities & Core Services
- **Modern Web Development**: Affordable web design Nairobi, custom website development Kenya, React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, sub-second Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.0s), 98+ Google Lighthouse scores, responsive websites, website redesigns.
- **African Fintech & E-Commerce**: Safaricom Daraja 3.0 M-Pesa STK Push, Paybill/Till C2B automated webhooks, MTN Mobile Money & Airtel Money East Africa (Uganda, Rwanda, Tanzania), PayFast and Ozow (South Africa), WooCommerce M-Pesa integration, multi-currency KES/USD checkouts.
- **Mobile Application Development**: Custom Android app development Kenya, cross-platform Flutter and React Native apps, biometric login, offline SQLite caching, M-Pesa in-app payments, Google Play & Apple App Store publishing.
- **Custom CRM, ERP & Invoicing Software**: Bespoke CRM development Nairobi, business software Kenya, online invoicing systems, automated PDF invoice generators, inventory management, workflow automation, and KRA eTIMS fiscal integration.
- **CMS, LMS & Community Portals**: Custom WordPress development Nairobi, WooCommerce Kenya, affordable Learning Management Systems (LMS), school management systems, NGO websites Kenya, and church website design.
- **Point of Sale (POS) Systems & Hardware (Kenya)**: Cloud-based POS software, on-premise lifetime licenses, 80mm thermal printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, touch monitors, and complete bundles with real-time KRA eTIMS QR invoice compliance.
- **High-ROI Digital Marketing & SEO**: Affordable SEO optimization Kenya, technical SEO audits, Google Ads PPC management, Google Business Profile local 3-pack ranking, content marketing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- **Corporate Branding & Design Tokens**: UI/UX design in Figma, vector logo design Nairobi, 20+ page brand guidelines, company profiles, and corporate stationery.
- **Nearshore & Offshore Outsourcing**: Outsource web development to Africa, hire vetted Kenyan developers, timezone-aligned engineering for European and international teams (UTC+3).
- **Regional Hubs Served**: Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret, Thika, Kigali (Rwanda), Kampala (Uganda), Dar es Salaam (Tanzania), and South Africa.

## Verified Agency Performance Metrics
- **Projects Completed**: 65+ commercial deployments
- **Client Retention Rate**: 98%
- **Average Client ROI Multiplier**: 4.6x
- **Typical Delivery Sprints**: 4 to 8 weeks fixed-bid milestone cycles
- **Post-Launch Warranty**: 30-day zero-cost bug fix guarantee with SLA response times

## Engineering Commitments
- **100% In-House Nairobi Studio**: No unvetted third-party outsourcing; direct access to senior software architects.
- **Full IP & Source Code Ownership**: Complete Git repository transfer, deployment pipelines, and database schemas provided upon project handover.
- **Zero Proprietary Lock-In**: Built on standard open-source enterprise technologies.
